quarterly_data.quarter: Tri Chemical Laboratories semi-annual report: H1 FY2027 (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: First half FY2027 (February 1 - July 31, 2026), semi-annual report: management says it continued strengthening production and quality-control systems to meet growing demand for new materials for generative AI and for existing products. H1 R&D expenses were JPY 373,452 thousand (prior-year H1 JPY 294,060 thousand) and purchases of property, plant and equipment JPY 2,972,317 thousand. Prior-year H1 comparisons for the sales breakdown: China JPY 4,654,426 thousand, Taiwan JPY 3,616,039 thousand, Japan JPY 2,216,740 thousand, Korea JPY 1,304,081 thousand; High-k JPY 6,082,464 thousand, Metal JPY 2,336,602 thousand, Etching JPY 1,823,150 thousand. No material contracts were decided or concluded in the half.
